SELECT ROUND(
    AVG(merchandise_minor) /
    (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'),
    2
)
FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'canceled'
    GROUP BY o.id
);

GROUP BY p.category;

WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, category, revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM category_revenue
)
SELECT month, category,
       CAST(revenue_minor AS REAL) /
           (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

SELECT c.name,
       SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor)
           FROM order_items oi
           WHERE oi.order_id = o.id
       ), 0)) * 1.0 / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       )
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

WITH item_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS total
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS total
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at),
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
                THEN COALESCE(i.total, 0) - COALESCE(r.total, 0)
                ELSE 0 END)
       / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
          FROM shop_meta
          WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN item_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

LIMIT 4;

SELECT p.name,
       p.price_minor * 1.0 / m.value,
       MIN(i.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 / m.value
FROM products AS p
CROSS JOIN shop_meta AS m
LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'kitchen_dining'
  AND m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
GROUP BY p.id;

GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, category, revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT month, category,
       CAST(revenue_minor AS REAL) /
           (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
            FROM shop_meta
            WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

SELECT c.name
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
  AND p.category IN ('kitchen_dining', 'outdoor_sports', 'home_office', 'audio_gear', 'home_decor', 'kids_toys')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) = 6;

       SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor)
           FROM order_items AS oi
           WHERE oi.order_id = o.id

GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

WITH item_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT SUBSTR(o.placed_at, 1, 7),
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
                THEN COALESCE(i.total_minor, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_minor, 0)
                ELSE 0
           END) / CAST(m.value AS REAL)
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN item_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.placed_at, 1, 7)
ORDER BY 1;

       p.price_minor * 1.0 / CAST(m.value AS INTEGER),
       MIN(oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 / CAST(m.value AS INTEGER)
FROM products AS p
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
WHERE p.category = 'kitchen_dining'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price_minor, m.value;

    AVG(COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor)
        FROM order_items AS oi

        SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)

        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
    ),
    2
)
FROM orders AS o
WHERE o.status = 'canceled';

       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'DEU'
  AND o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category;

WITH months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT substr(placed_at, 1, 7) AS month
    FROM orders
),
revenue AS (
    SELECT substr(o.placed_at, 1, 7) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY substr(o.placed_at, 1, 7), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, category, revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM revenue
)
SELECT m.month, r.category,
       r.revenue_minor / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       )
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.month = m.month AND r.revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY m.month, r.category;

JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
  AND p.category IN (
    'kitchen_dining', 'outdoor_sports', 'home_office',
    'audio_gear', 'home_decor', 'kids_toys'
  )
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) = 6;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(refunds.created_at) - JULIANDAY(orders.delivered_at)), 2)
FROM refunds
JOIN orders ON orders.id = refunds.order_id
WHERE JULIANDAY(refunds.created_at) >= JULIANDAY(orders.delivered_at);

SELECT c.name
FROM customers AS c
WHERE (
    SELECT o.status
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.id
    ORDER BY o.placed_at DESC, o.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
) = 'canceled';

SELECT c.name,
       SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor)
           FROM order_items AS oi
           WHERE oi.order_id = o.id
       ), 0)) / CAST((
           SELECT value
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       ) AS REAL)
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

WITH item_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS total
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS total
  FROM refunds
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at),
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
                THEN COALESCE(i.total, 0) - COALESCE(r.total, 0)
                ELSE 0 END)
       / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
          FROM shop_meta
          WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN item_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT p.name,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2)
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING 100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor THEN 1 END) > 45 * COUNT(*);

SELECT c.name,
       CAST(julianday(date(MIN(o.placed_at))) - julianday(date(c.signup_date)) AS INTEGER)
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.segment = 'reseller_partner'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.signup_date
ORDER BY 2;
